purpose: Every system the mashup touches. One row per system.

rows.detail: common x1.0, rare x1.25, epic x1.5, legendary x1.75 applied to a chrome row's numbers
Opens only while resting at a Site of Grace. Lists every chrome row grouped by slot, with its tier, cost and effect text
One piece per slot (9 slots), like Cyberpunk. Any piece can be swapped or removed at the bench for free
Each piece costs capacity points by slot and tier; the player's capacity grows with level
0-100, refills 6 per second, spent by active chrome (Sandevistan, arm cannon, camo, blood pump)
Per row, counted in seconds, shown on the bench and in the HUD
Q - activates the installed operating system; opens the hack menu when the Cyberdeck is installed
E - toggles the installed arms implant onto the currently equipped weapon, or fires the arm cannon
X - fires the installed active piece: Optical Camo or Blood Pump
V - toggles Kiroshi markers on and off
F - opens the bench, only while at a Site of Grace
Always on while installed; no input
Reserved for rows marked not-possible
ImGui panel drawn over the game: charge meter, installed chrome by slot, active timers and cooldowns
Drawn by us in the game's frame: a Cyberpunk-style ripperdoc page. No Cyberpunk assets are shipped
Three hacks while the Cyberdeck is the OS: Overturn turns the target on its own squad, Overload lands a lightning burst, Blind staggers it
The nearest hostile within 30m in front of the camera; the HUD marks the picked target
Only one bullet-time source is active at a time; a stronger one overrides. Nanorelays extends the duration of any of them by 50%
Second Heart and Biomonitor arm themselves on rest at a Site of Grace and fire once
Our own file under the mod folder, written on install, swap and rest: which chrome sits in which slot, chosen tiers and remaining once-per-rest charges
Only our own keys are read; the game's own bindings are never remapped, and keys are blanked for the game only while a panel is open
Never touched: the mod only ever runs in the offline session Melty launches, with Easy Anti-Cheat off
